description:
Seasonal checklists for American homes and cars. Before the weather turns, we go through what to look at first: furnace filters and vents, drafts and weatherstripping, gutters and outdoor faucets, wipers, batteries and tires. For every item you get the warning signs, the small fix you can safely do yourself, and the point where the job belongs to a licensed professional.

The host of this channel is an AI-generated presenter, not a tradesman. The advice comes from manufacturer manuals and public guidance from the Department of Energy, ENERGY STAR, the Consumer Product Safety Commission, NHTSA and Ready.gov. We do not walk anyone through gas appliances, electrical panels, refrigerant or roof work: for those, call a pro.

Subscribe so the next season does not catch your house off guard.
